name: @hydronium/vite
description: Vite 8 build/dev adapter for Hydronium: the plugin wires island entry points into the build (islands are fetched at runtime by bootstrap.js, so nothing in Vite's graph imports them), enables the build manifest hydronium_ballad.plugins.vite_assets ingests, sets the cross-origin dev policy the Meteorite-served page needs, and publishes the bound dev origin for the Lua server to read. Kept separate from @hydronium/dom-client so consuming that runtime never pulls in a `vite` dependency.
